subject: Intermittent 502 errors on merchant-dashboard API calls
body: Multiple merchants reported 502 errors when loading transaction history. Appears to be related to connection pool exhaustion on the BFF layer. Rate: ~2% of requests affected.

comments.author: U009
comments.body: Confirmed connection pool exhaustion on the BFF. Increasing pool size from 20 to 50 as a temporary fix.

comments.author: U012
comments.body: Three enterprise merchants (Acme Corp, GlobalTech, PayRight) have opened support tickets about this.
